name: EEA-ESEM 2027 Congress
organizer: European Economic Association (EEA) and Econometric Society (ES); hosted by the Prague University of Economics and Business
venue: Prague University of Economics and Business
expected_note: Full call not yet published. The Econometric Society event page already lists 'Submissions Open: December 15, 2026' and 'Submissions Close: February 23, 2027' (ES program chairs Chryssi Giannitsarou and Blaise Melly). In 2026 only full papers were accepted, one paper per author to each of the EEA and ES sessions, and at least one co-author had to be a member of the association submitted to. 2026 registration: EUR 495 members / EUR 990 non-members (PhD students EUR 315 / EUR 630); fees are indexed to host-country inflation.
